name: stress-scout
description: Watches your code while it's being written; when something risky changes or the session goes idle, it stress-tests it in a sandbox copy and offers a fix it has already verified.

triageModel.title: Triage model
triageModel.description: Cheap model that decides whether a change is worth a stress test.

testerModel.title: Tester model
testerModel.description: Model the background tester runs on (writes, runs and fixes the stress test).

maxRunsPerSession.title: Max automatic test runs per session
maxRunsPerSession.description: Hard cap on automatic deep runs; /stress still runs on demand.

maxSweepsPerSession.title: Max idle sweeps per session
maxSweepsPerSession.description: How many of the automatic runs may go to idle sweeps of untested code.

minMinutesBetweenRuns.title: Minutes between automatic runs
minMinutesBetweenRuns.description: Minimum gap between two automatic deep runs.

quietSeconds.title: Quiet seconds before a change scan
quietSeconds.description: How long edits must settle before the change is triaged.

maxWaitSeconds.title: Max seconds between scans while editing
maxWaitSeconds.description: During non-stop editing, scan at least this often.

idleSeconds.title: Idle seconds after a turn
idleSeconds.description: How long after Claude finishes a turn before an idle scan.

sweepWhenIdle.title: Sweep untested code when idle
sweepWhenIdle.description: When nothing changed, test the riskiest area not tested yet.

sweepMinutes.title: Minutes between idle sweeps
sweepMinutes.description: Minimum gap between two idle sweeps.

maxDollarsPerSession.title: Max dollars per session
maxDollarsPerSession.description: Automatic work (runs, sweeps, idea tries, discoveries, edit reviews) stops at this total cost for the session; 0 means no cap. /stress still runs on demand.

maxDollarsPerRun.title: Max dollars per test run
maxDollarsPerRun.description: The tester stops when one run reaches this cost (claude --max-budget-usd).

openPaneOnStart.title: Open the Stress Scout pane in every session
openPaneOnStart.description: Open the pane when a session starts (or when the app first attaches to it). Close it any time; /stress show brings it back.

autoApplyVerifiedFixes.title: Hand verified fixes to Claude automatically
autoApplyVerifiedFixes.description: When a test proves its own fix and the session has been idle for the idle seconds, send the fix to Claude without a tap.

testerOffline.title: Run the tester without network
testerOffline.description: Cut the network off from the commands the tester runs (sandbox-exec on macOS, unshare on Linux); the tester itself still reaches the model.

suggestImprovements.title: Suggest improvements
suggestImprovements.description: Now and then, the same triage call also suggests one small improvement to what you are building; it shows under Ideas in the pane, and /stress try N builds and checks it in the sandbox.

maxIdeasPerSession.title: Max ideas per session
maxIdeasPerSession.description: Hard cap on suggested improvements shown in one session.

discoverSources.title: Discovery may read fresh sources
discoverSources.description: A discovery run may use WebSearch and WebFetch to find release notes, changelogs, papers and benchmarks newer than the model's cutoff. Off keeps discovery to measurements in the sandbox.

discoverWhenIdle.title: Research an idea when idle
discoverWhenIdle.description: On by default: when nothing else is due, research the newest idea without waiting for Run it. Off: a discovery only starts when you press Run it.

maxDollarsPerDiscovery.title: Max dollars per discovery
maxDollarsPerDiscovery.description: A discovery stops at this cost and records a partial result.

maxDiscoveriesPerSession.title: Max discoveries per session
maxDiscoveriesPerSession.description: Hard cap on discoveries started in one session; 0 turns discovery off.

claudePath.title: Path to the claude binary
claudePath.description: Leave empty to use the running Claude Code's own binary.

pauseAtRateLimitPercent.title: Pause at rate-limit %
pauseAtRateLimitPercent.description: Skip automatic runs while your 5-hour or weekly usage window (or a gateway's spend limit) is at or above this percent.

testerTimeoutMinutes.title: Tester timeout (minutes)
testerTimeoutMinutes.description: Give up on a tester run after this long.
